pages.text: A nonempty assembly that has not passed validation, for example because of missing slots, invalid expressions or IDs. All nodes and entered text are preserved.

pages.title: Continue editing
pages.text: Return it to a table and hover the status button to inspect errors, then fix slots or parameters and apply. A wand can store it but cannot cast it.$(br2)Removing all children restores its typed empty core and retains root parameters.
